_comment: Per-character WARDROBE brief: the style a 28-look pack should be written in.
Jeremy, 2026-10-04: 'what do their current game assets look like style-wise,
just sample a few or 1 from each type of clothing set' - so every brief below
was read off the outfits already shipped in chillafterdark, not invented.
USE: `sourcemode assets plan <char> --brief` expands this into the 28 looks
work 5). The brief is the DECISION; the look list is the expansion of it.
This is deliberately separate from appearance.json: appearance is who she is
and goes into every prompt, wardrobe is what she wears and goes into the plan.
`work` is the one category that is not a taste - it is her JOB, which the game
fixes. Get that from characters.js, never from the vibe.
`avoid` exists because a character can have a line she does not cross, and a
generated pack with no memory of it will cross it every time.

ash._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. Waitress at Obsidian.
ash.style: edgy downtown party girl - denim, leather, cropped knits, sheer black tights, chunky boots; shapes: cropped tops over high-waisted denim shorts and micro skirts; cropped moto jackets; bare midriff is normal for her
ash.palette: black and denim blue as the base, with one hot accent per look - cobalt, burnt orange, red
ash.avoid: nothing prim or preppy - she is the opposite of wholesome

outfits.workout: bright sports bra and leggings, exposed midriff
